faq.a: Open pokebonk.com in a desktop or phone browser and choose Play as a guest; no sign-up is needed. PokeBonk is a free, unofficial fan game by Charcher. Pick one of the three starters, then follow the upgrade cards during the run.

faq.q: What is the best build in PokeBonk?

faq.a: Yes. PokeBonk has a Co-op Beta for 2–4 trainers with room creation, invites and code-based joining. The server can restrict or pause access, so check the Co-op screen before inviting friends.

faq.q: Can you play PokeBonk on mobile or download it?
faq.a: Yes. The browser game runs on Android and iPhone with touch controls. The original game’s Apps menu lists downloads for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android; there is no iOS app, so use the browser on iPhone.

faq.q: How do you catch Pokémon in PokeBonk?
faq.a: Complete the partner’s League requirement, then find its encounter and weaken it. Ordinary League partners also need the nearby throw; legendaries join once weakened, and the ball only matters for their shiny.

faq.q: How do you get Mewtwo in PokeBonk?
faq.a: Have 60 League members, Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres in your League, and clear Rocky Desert on Hard. The 45-minute Mewtwo in Survival is a separate encounter.

Check where it fails: if pokebonk.com does not load at all, the host is down; if it loads but the game will not connect, read the server message on the entry screen. Keep your Guest session and do not clear site data while you check.
